owner_posts.post_text:
PORTFOLIO PRINTING & BINDING

1. Hardcover Binding (Case Binding)
For a premium portfolio, case binding ensures maximum durability and a flat, professional presentation.

The Core: We utilize a rigid 2mm to 3mm imported greyboard for the cover structure to prevent warping.

The Wrap: The cover design is printed on a 130 GSM to 150 GSM liner, which is then tightly wrapped and glued over the board.

The Spine: Can be crafted as a square spine or a rounded spine depending on the page count. For portfolios, a square spine delivers a sleek, modern look.

2. Inside Pages: 170 GSM Imported Stock
170 GSM (Grams per Square Meter) is an ideal "sweet spot" weight for high-end portfolio inner pages. It provides a heavy, distinctively premium feel without being overly stiff.

Imported Quality: Imported art paper features superior opacity, a ultra-smooth surface profile, and high brightness, ensuring exceptional ink holdout and color accuracy.

Finish Selection:

Matte Coated (Recommended): Eliminates glare, making text highly readable and giving photographic portfolios a sophisticated, editorial look.

Gloss Coated: Makes colors vibrant, high-contrast, and punchy. Excellent for vivid commercial designs or high-saturation imagery.

3. Flyleaf & Endpapers (Passing)
Because the inside pages are 170 GSM, the endpapers (the pages glued directly to the inside of the hard covers) should ideally be a thicker, uncoated stock (around 220 GSM to 250 GSM) to structurally anchor the heavy inner block

HIGH QUALITY CANVAS PRINTING

Canvas printing is the process of transferring digital images or artwork onto a high-quality cotton or polyester fabric using advanced digital printers

Menu Cards for Hospitality Clients


For restaurants, cafés, or events, we create custom menu cards that elevate your clients’ brand experience, offering premium quality and tailored designs for every dining environment.

Posters & Large Format Prints That Demand Attention

featured_reviews.review_text: I've had a truly great experience with Prince Printer! From the moment I reached out, their team was incredibly responsive, professional, and genuinely helpful. They understood exactly what I needed, offered practical suggestions, and delivered high-quality prints that exceeded my expectations. Whether it's for personal projects or professional needs, I can always count on their consistency, quick turnaround, and attention to detail. It’s rare to find a service that combines quality work with such warmth and reliability — and Prince Printer does just that. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for dependable and friendly printing solutions!

Your trust and recommendation mean a lot to us, and we look forward to assisting you with both personal and professional projects in the future.
